name: Faceless Date
source:
Suzanne is a 20-year-old stylist and her life cannot be more perfect by fulfilling her childhood dream of working backstage at Tantalus Theatre. But one thing she misses out on is finding lasting love. She's still young, yet she can't resist the thought that her opportunities are already running out in the already limited dating pool of women of her age. Then she received a DM in the dating app from the mysterious Evelyn. Yes, there are many red flags, like how Evelyn doesn't have any photos of her face. However, she seems to be a lovely person from the conversations they had and there's always that secret ability Suzanne can rely on, so what can go wrong?

[From [url=https://gaming-variety-potato.itch.io/faceless-date]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
苏珊娜是一名20岁的造型师，终于实现了儿时的梦想，在坦塔罗斯剧院从事幕后工作。她的生活简直完美无缺，唯独还没找到一段长久的爱情。她明明还年轻，却忍不住觉得，在同龄女性本就有限的交友圈里，自己的机会正在一点点流失。这时，神秘的伊芙琳通过约会应用给她发来了私信。没错，有不少危险信号，比如伊芙琳一张露脸照都没有。不过，从两人的交谈来看，她似乎是个可爱的人。再说，苏珊娜还有那项秘密能力可以依靠，又能出什么事呢？

（摘自[url=https://gaming-variety-potato.itch.io/faceless-date]itch.io[/url]）
